# 0001: PDF generated by `core`, executed in the browser

**Status:** accepted (2026-11-04)

## Decision

Sheet layout and PDF generation live in `core` as a pure function: lines + sheet options + already-fetched image bytes → PDF bytes. `web` fetches images directly from `cards.scryfall.io` and calls `core`. The server never processes images.

## Why

- The 63×88 mm requirement is the one thing the MVP cannot get wrong. Keeping generation in `core` lets a Node test re-read the PDF and assert geometry in points, with no browser.
- `cards.scryfall.io` answers `access-control-allow-origin: *` (checked 2026-11-04), so the browser can fetch images itself.
- The VPS stays small: no image processing, no PDF storage.

## Consequences

- The PDF library must run in both browser and Node.
- Mobile memory is the bottleneck: JPG "large" is the default, PNG is opt-in with a warning.
- Moving generation server-side would reopen this ADR.
